subject: POV orchestration: success gates & evaluation strategy
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lang <anna@meditrek.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POV approach

Thanks again for the call earlier today, Anna — good context and clear priorities. Quick recap and a proposed Proof-of-Value (POV) orchestration so we can operationalize evaluation without blocking your product timelines.

Highlights from discovery
- Primary goals: reduce triage time for support prompts, improve answer precision for clinical FAQs, and keep 95th pct latency under 250ms for curated flows.
- Constraints: PHI-lite (no direct patient identifiers in the test set), procurement needs SOC2 and a single-page SOW for legal, and limited engineering bandwidth for instrumentation.

Proposed POV orchestration (high-level)
1) Scope: 2-week POV run across 3 curated flows (Triage, Clinical QA, Prioritization). See attached trial-scope.xlsx for detailed sample sizes.
2) Evaluation mix: hybrid approach — short offline benchmark + a 7–10 day shadowing pass on live but sampled traffic for production-like latency/behavior signals.
   - Offline: deterministic dataset (500 examples per flow) to measure intent accuracy, hallucination rate, and token-level cost. Easy to reproduce, fast iteration.
   - Shadow (online): route a 2% sample of real traffic to Redwood in parallel to your endpoint to surface latency distributions, token spikes, and rare failure modes. Does not serve users.
3) Success gates (pass/fail criteria):
   - Accuracy: >= 88% on offline gold set for Clinical QA (weighted by severity).
   - Hallucination: < 2% critical hallucination rate on audit sample.
   - Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms on shadow samples for curated flows.
   - Operational: infra stability (no more than two safety incidents requiring rollback).
4) Ownership & roles:
   - Redwood (Solutions) — instrumenting the shadow routing, providing eval dashboards, and model tuning.
   - Meditrek (Product) — dataset curation, labeling audits, and final acceptance on quality thresholds.
   - Optional: we can loop in your security lead for SOC2 checklist items (we have a one-page evidence pack).

Open questions / options where we need your call
- Shadow vs. full-simulated-batch: if you cannot sample production traffic, we can run a larger offline synthetic replay; however, this loses real-time latency signals.
- Labeling: do you want Redwood to manage an initial audit batch (we can do 200 samples) or will your team own labels?

Next steps (proposed)
- Can you confirm: (a) permission to sample 2% of the three flows, (b) whether your legal team needs a draft SOW before we schedule infra work?
- If yes, I’ll send a one-page SOW + calendar invite to kick off a 30-minute tech alignment next Tue/Thu.

Attachments: trial-scope.xlsx, pov-eval-rubric.csv

Thanks — I’ll hold off on carving capacity until we lock the sampling approach.

—
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Anna Lang <anna@meditrek.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Procurement <it-procurement@meditrek.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 17:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POV approach

Thanks Priya — this is exactly the kind of concrete plan we needed. A few clarifications from my side:
- We can approve sampling on the three flows but need the sampling to be non-PHI (we'll strip identifiers before the sample hits vendor infra).
- Legal wants the one-page SOW before we approve any access (happy to get that on our side once you share).
- For evaluation, the measurement priorities are: 1) hallucination rate (safety), 2) clinically-relevant accuracy, 3) latency. Weighting should reflect safety first.

We'd prefer Redwood to run the initial 200-audit sample for speed; our team will validate labels after the batch.

Can you send the SOW and a proposed calendar for the tech sync?

—
Anna Lang
Director of ML | Meditrek Health
anna@meditrek.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + proposed POV approach — alignment request

Fwding Anna's note and our recap. Need quick alignment on recommended eval choreography and owners before I send the SOW.

Recommended default (my call): hybrid — offline benchmark (our lab) + 7–10 day shadow at 2% sample for the three chosen flows. Rationale:
- Offline gives reproducible accuracy/hallucination metrics (fast iteration).
- Shadow gives latency and rare-case behavior under production routing without impacting users.

Asks:
- Ben: can Redwood carve a small dedicated pool/namespace for Meditrek shadowing? We need predictable 95th pct targets in the dashboard. If yes, what throughput cap do you want? (Anna expects up to ~60 reqs/min across flows at peak.)
- Neha: can you own the 200-audit labeling pass and final rubric adjustments? I attached pov-eval-rubric.csv with suggested weights (safety:50%, accuracy:30%, latency:20%).

If either of you thinks full simulated-batch (offline-only) is safer here because of the PHI constraint, call it out — we'll propose that as Plan B to the customer.

—
Priya

Subject: POV plan + immediate next steps (timeline & owners)

Hi Anna — quick update and proposed execution plan based on internal alignment.

1) What we'll do (agreed plan)
- Hybrid POV: offline benchmark (deterministic gold set) + 7-day shadow at 2% sample on the three flows.
- Redwood to run initial 200-sample audit and deliver labeled batch for Meditrek review.
- Redwood to provision a dedicated namespace/pool (Ben to manage).

2) Success gates (finalized)
- Safety (hallucination): < 2% critical hallucination rate on the audit sample.
- Clinical accuracy: >= 88% on weighted offline gold set.
- Latency: 95th pct < 250ms on shadowed traffic for curated flows.

3) Timeline (fast-track option)
- Nov 6: Redwood sends a one-page SOW + infra readiness checklist (action: Priya).
- Nov 8: Tech sync (30m) — attendees: Priya, Ben, Neha, Anna, your infra lead (action: calendar invite sent).
- Nov 9–11: Infra carve + shadow config (Ben).
- Nov 12–18: POV run (offline leak-in + 7-day shadow).
- Nov 19–20: Label audit, scoring, and final acceptance decision.

4) Action items (owners)
- Priya: send SOW + calendar invite (by EOD Nov 6).
- Ben: confirm capacity reservation and provide sampling header details (before Nov 8).
- Anna / Meditrek: confirm data stripping approach and give legal feedback on SOW (by Nov 7).
- Neha: review rubric and be ready to own labeling audit (start Nov 12).

Attachments: trial-scope.xlsx, pov-eval-rubric.csv

If that matches your expectations, please reply "ACK" and we’ll kick the SOW over to procurement. If you want a fully offline Plan B (no shadow), say so and we’ll prepare an adjusted timeline and acceptance criteria.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
